in_sanskrit.name: Hrushi
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Green Plant, Wealth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Hrushi एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘hrusha’, which means ‘green plant’. Hrushi is a name that symbolizes growth, nourishment, and beauty. It is believed to bring wealth and prosperity to the person bearing this name.
